name: Has Phases
description: Farm is organized into phases - parent warehouses grouping the greenhouses or blocks (e.g. Phase 1, Phase 2)

name: Has Greenhouses
description: Production units are greenhouses (created as warehouses), typical for flower farms

name: Has Blocks
description: Production units are blocks (created as warehouses), typical for coffee and avocado farms

name: Has Sections
description: Greenhouses are divided into sections - each section covers a range of beds

name: Has Beds
description: Greenhouses contain numbered beds with dimensions

name: Has Triads
description: Trees are grouped into triads - three-tree sampling units used for scouting and monitoring
